parameters.name: AutoRenew
parameters.description: Enable auto-renewal. This parameter is valid only when payType is set to PrePaid. Auto-renewal is disabled by default.

parameters.name: Cu
parameters.description: Number of CUs. A CU (Compute Unit) is the basic unit of service measurement. 1 CU = 1 CPU core + 4 GiB memory. For memory-enhanced instance family, 1 CU = 1 CPU core + 8 GiB memory.

parameters.name: Duration
parameters.description: Duration. This parameter is valid only when payType is set to PrePaid.

parameters.name: PricingCycle
parameters.description:
Unit of subscription duration:

- Month

- Year

This parameter is valid only when payType is set to PrePaid.
